name: Belial
source:
"You don't want to be bound together with me? ...In this extraordinarily sweet relationship?"
A demon of temptation and desire.
Becuase of Lucifer he fell into a dangerous situation so in order to help the protagonist who he has become interested in he makes a contract with her.
